name: Soundwave
author: Daniel Mędrek (MedrekIT)
description: Live btop-style dot sound wave in the bar that follows the real audio, with a now-playing card: seek bar, transport controls, and a button that jumps to the playing window.

barWidget.description: Animated dot sound wave driven by cava; appears only while something is audible. Click for the now-playing card, middle-click to play/pause.

schema.label: Dot columns
schema.description: How many dot columns the bar wave has (fewer on a vertical bar if they don't fit).

schema.label: Wave height (%)
schema.description: How much of the bar's thickness the wave may use.
